summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting in the rich repo, uncommitted. Changes: SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 added to ControlType and Tuple[ControlType, str] added to ControlCode; CONTROL_CODES_FORMAT entry emitting ESC ] 0 ; title BEL; Control.title(title) classmethod; Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor (buffers when is_terminal, returns True/False, no Windows calls); legacy renderer branch calling term.set_title(title) once per control; CHANGELOG Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200; tests added in test_console.py (skipped on Windows), test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Not verified: tests and Black were not run per instructions, so all checks were by reading. Line lengths were checked by hand against 88.
